title: Great
body:
Please add a feature of To Do list. At the start of the day, the user plan to his day by adding some tasks with times. Then starts to do it one by one. That will help him to keep track of his objectives.

Also, Automate some habits as much as possible. For example: enable the user to link a habit with a specific geo location like when he goes to gym, automatically the habit of exercise done. Another example: make the link or integration with other apps. I think there are many ideas to automate the adoption of habits, and you can develop this gradually. That will help the user to save his time and encouraging him to adhere to habits, especially when he has a lot of habits every day. Also, I hope you add “To-do list” for daily tasks, it will be a useful feature to increase and improve the productivity besides the tracker of habits.

body: Having used the habit tracker app for several weeks now, I can confidently say it has become an indispensable tool in my daily routine. The user-friendly interface makes it incredibly easy to set up and track various habits, from drinking more water to practicing mindfulness. What sets this app apart is its insightful analytics, providing valuable data on my progress and areas for improvement. Customizable reminders keep me accountable, ensuring I stay on track with my goals. Overall, this app has greatly enhanced my productivity and well-being, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to cultivate positive habits in their life.
